items.heading: Bryndzove Halusky
details: Key ingredients: potato dumplings, sheep cheese, bacon
Mix grated potato with flour into a soft dumpling dough.
Drop small pieces of dough into boiling water and cook until they float.
Toss the cooked dumplings with soft sheep's cheese.
Top with crispy fried bacon bits before serving.

items.heading: Kapustnica
details: Key ingredients: sauerkraut, sausage, mushroom, dried plum
Simmer sauerkraut with sliced sausage and mushroom.
Add a few dried plums for subtle sweetness.
Cook slowly until the flavors meld and the soup thickens.
Serve hot with bread.
